summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Consnow MVP. Created /app/backend/tests/test_consnow_api.py (28 pytest cases) covering auth, user search, friendship flow, scope updates (all 6 valid + invalid), location ping with reverse-geocoding, timeline/latest/recent for self and friends, and scope='off' filtering. All 28 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI tested via Playwright mobile viewport: login, all 4 tabs (Map/Friends/Timeline/Profile), search modal with friend lookup, Ping Now button, and logout button are all functional. Reverse-geocoding confirmed working — Mumbai coords resolved to 'Lower Parel'.

minor.issue: Dead code on line 310: first cursor query uses {'pair': uid} (treats pair as a scalar) and is immediately overwritten on line 312. Cosmetic; second query is correct.

issues: Multiple 'shadow*' style props deprecated warnings — should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+

react_native_issues.issue: tabBarTestID prop does not render as data-testid on the web tab buttons (expo-router limitation). Tab navigation still works via text labels. If main agent wants reliable testID on tabs, consider a custom tabBar with explicit testID on TouchableOpacity wrappers. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: clean up dead cursor line in /api/friends/list (server.py:310).
Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and remove pointerEvents from props per RN deprecation warnings.
Optional: wrap tabs in custom buttons with testID if testID-based tab navigation is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 543 lines — close to the 700-line guideline. As more routes are added, consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/friends.py, routers/locations.py.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is committed in the repo — production deployments must rotate this.
/api/locations/ping calls Google Geocoding API synchronously inside the request — for high-volume background pings, consider caching by lat/lng grid (~100m) to reduce billable API calls.

Scope semantics: scope acts as a *time delay* on visible data ('ended_at <= now - scope_minutes'). This is correctly implemented but the field name 'scope' could be misread as 'history horizon'. Documentation suggests this is intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows tested: login, 4 tabs, search, ping, logout)

seed_data_creation: Tests create unique TEST_ users via signup with uuid suffix; no production seed data modified. The 3 pre-seeded accounts (alice, bob, testuser) work correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://location-log-22.preview.emergentagent.com. Seed users in /app/memory/test_credentials.md all valid. tabBarTestID does not propagate to web — use page.get_by_text('Friends', exact=True).first.click() for tab nav. Reverse-geocoding works (Mumbai 19.0760,72.8777 → 'Lower Parel'). Run regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_consnow_api.py -v.
